why: A report becomes available but DECLARES an unsatisfied prerequisite, so instead of accumulating it parks in the ready-queue ring C(14) at slot mod 12. Nothing accumulates; last-accumulation timestamps must NOT move.
family_explainer: Same service and lifecycle as the storage family, but each work report carries a single work item, isolating the per-report machinery (availability, queueing, ordering) from multi-item aggregation.
events: 5 validator assurance(s): core 0 has 3, core 1 has 5 vote(s). A report becomes AVAILABLE when votes exceed 2/3 of 6 validators (i.e. ≥ 5).
READY QUEUE: at least one available report declares unsatisfied prerequisites — it parks in ring 4 of C(14) instead of accumulating, and will run when its dependencies accumulate.
